review.description: Contributor S3 qualifier now measures sampled concurrent workload RSS separately from individual-process metrics, requires positive root/child coverage and retains interruption/failure outcomes with safe cleanup. All merged strict inventory, result cardinality, timing and failure-stopping behavior remains; hosted integration is excluded.
review.implementation: Inspected integrated process_stat/WorkloadMemory session and observed-descendant identities, WNOWAIT direct-leader lifetime through final killpg, identity-revalidated pidfds for other targets, recording signal handlers, 200ms TERM grace and bounded post-KILL waits. Main restores merged math finite/nonnegative guard and handles failed/interrupted samples before later runs. All main web/backend/hosted/foundational source stays unchanged. New ancestry edges now require a held parent pidfd to remain live across fresh child PPID/identity capture and parent start-time revalidation; a stale numeric parent row cannot contaminate known ownership. Same-session selection still depends on the direct root remaining unreaped through final capture/signaling.
review.tests: Read all nine baseline assertions retained through measure-boundary stubs: complete order, zero individualmetrics, earlydiscovery/baseline rejection, exactinventory/project/result/status/retry and invalidmetric stopping. Real four-allocation hierarchy establishes concurrentRSS. Missingcoverage/readfailure tests reject partialmemory. Six signal/phase combinations exercise real SIGINT/SIGTERM during launch(Popen active), measurement andcleanup with owned separate-session children, stale identity and unrelatedsentinel, restoredhandlers/reaping/interruptedsummary. Independentstalledprobe fallback remains. Deterministicdeadline tests propagate descendant/directchild timeouts into mainfailure, closepidfds and retain bounded TERM/KILL. Targetingdenial beforelaunch and duringcleanup remain covered. Added eight deterministic scan interleavings across session/remembered parents, replacement/exit before acquisition or during child reread, asserting exclusion, no known contamination and no unrelated TERM/KILL in cleanup. Stable cross-session reparenting remains accepted. Three ancestry guard mutants detected. Read-failure child lifetime now uses a pipe released by the injected second-sample failure, not wall-clock sleep. Read-failure assertion now executes in an isolated subprocess controlled by a subreaper with an independent timeout and finally cleanup. The callback-suppressed regression proves timeout recovery, probe/pipe-child termination and reaping, and unrelated sibling survival. Production sampler and prior ancestry proofs remain unchanged.
